title: A database to support the evaluation of gender biases in GPT-4o output
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating gender-related biases in LLM-generated language, based on a normative framework derived from feminist standpoint theory.
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion; its focus is on gender bias.
references: Elizabeth S. Anderson. 1999. What Is the Point of Equality? Ethics, 109(2):287–337.
